Long Island University on Instagram: "Big things are happening at LIU!

LIU is ranked in the top 7% of Research Universities in the country and is constructing a 40,000 square foot College of Science Research facility, housing the Dassault Systèmes Center of Excellence and the nation’s first academic program in Digital Engineering. 

The building includes fabrication labs, a research accelerator, and collaborative faculty and student research space. LIU continues to accelerate the exceptional."
